meanings.en: to lead, to guide, to drive

догнать.gloss: to catch up with, to catch

meanings.en: to catch up with, to overtake
meanings.note: Prefix 'до-' marks reaching a boundary or finishing the remainder of an action (stem 'гнать'). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to catch up with, to catch', paired with 'догонять'.

examples.trans: The chubby girl won't catch you.

meanings.note: Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'are dawdling, digging around'.
